CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
August 23, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of August 9, 2022 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of August, 2022.
8.1 Minutes of 8-9-22 SS
8.1 Minutes of 8-9-22 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated August 23, 2022 in the total amount of $1,630,869.26.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-07, SANTA GERTRUDES CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-07, Santa Gertrudes Avenue Corridor Traffic Signal Upgrades; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.3 CIP No. 2018-07
8.4
APPROVAL OF THE MEALS ON WHEELS SPAGHETTI DINNER FUNDRAISING EVENT IN THE LA MIRADA ACTIVITY CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for the use of the La Mirada Activity Center by Meals on Wheels for the Lou Piltz Spaghetti Dinner fundraising event.
8.4 Approval of Use of Facility
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-20 APPROVING THE ISSUANCE OF REVENUE BONDS BY THE CALIFORNIA ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY FOR BIOLA UNIVERSITY - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 22-20 approving the issuance of revenue bonds by the California Enterprise Authority in an aggregate principal amount of $34,500,000 for the purpose of refinancing certain educational facilities and certain other matters relating thereto for the benefit of Biola University.
9.1 PH: Resolution No. 22-20
10.

10.1
SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 724 AMENDING LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE 9 BY ADDING CHAPTER 9.140 ESTABLISHING REGULATIONS PROHIBITING THE UNLAWFUL POSSESSION OF CATALYTIC CONVERTERS IN THE CITY - It is recommended the City Council accept for second reading and adopt Ordinance No. 724 amending La Mirada Municipal Code Title 9 by adding Chapter 9.140 establishing regulations prohibiting the unlawful possession of catalytic converters in the City of La Mirada, by title only, and waive further reading.
10.1 Ordinance No. 724 - 2nd Reading
